scripts.deploy: astro build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=lector-site
scripts.dev:api: astro build && wrangler pages dev dist --d1 DB --compatibility-date=2026-04-13
scripts.requests:list: wrangler d1 execute lector-language-requests --remote --command "SELECT created_at, language, requested_name, email, country, note FROM language_requests WHERE unsubscribed_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200"
scripts.requests:counts: wrangler d1 execute lector-language-requests --remote --command "SELECT language, count(*) AS people FROM language_requests WHERE unsubscribed_at IS NULL GROUP BY language ORDER BY people DESC"
